items.docs:
Retrieve full opinion data by ID, citation, or docket number. Supports bulk reads of up to 100 items per request. Provide exactly one of `opinion_ids`, `citations`, or `docket` (not multiple).
Lookup methods: `opinion_ids` (direct lookup, up to 100), `citations` (reporter citation, case-insensitive, up to 100), and `docket` (docket number + court; single lookup, may return multiple opinions).
When using `citations` or `docket`, a lookup may match multiple opinions (e.g., majority and dissent fro
